body: Maligavila is a village in Sri Lanka, approximately 15 kilometers (9.3 mi) south from Monaragala and 9 kilometers (5.6 mi) from Okkampitiya in the Monaragala District. The Maligawila Buddha statue is a standing figure of the Buddha in Sri Lanka, which has been carved out of a large limestone rock during the 7th century by a prince named Aggabodhi. It is the tallest free-standing ancient statue of the Buddha found in the country and site of several important archaeological pieces, including a free-standing 11 meters (36 ft 1.1 in) or 12 meters (39 ft 4.4 in) tall limestone statue of Buddha , claimed in some quarters to be the tallest free-standing statue of Buddha in the world,
title: Maligavila buddha statue is a large limestone rock during the 7th century by a prince named Aggabodhi.

A wonderful standing Buddha statue with 45 feet in height, carved out of limestone which had decayed due to negligence & was broken into large pieces. The Maligawila Buddha statue is located close to the village of Maligawila between Okkampitiya and Maligavila. This is not a touristy place but very much part of the history of Sri Lanka. title: Maligawila Buddha statue
body: Maligawila - 40km to the Resort Complex The Maligawila Buddha statue is a standing figure of the Buddha in Sri Lanka, which has been carved out of a large limestone rock during the 7th century by a prince named Aggabodhi. It is the tallest free-standing ancient statue of the Buddha found in the country. It had been broken into several pieces by the time it was found in 1951. The statue was reconstructed and raised again in 1980 under the direction of the then president Ranasinghe Premadasa.

title: One of the best Buddha Statues
body: Visiting Maligawila was in my mind for a long time. Made my journey Arugam Bay to Monaragala. From Monaragala it is around 90 minutes by public transport. Maligawila is the tallest free standing Buddha Statue in Sri Lanka. It is 11 meters tall and is made out of limestone. When it was found in the 1950's it was broken and fallen down. At that time they tried ti restore but failed. In the 1980's a local engineering team made the restoration. About 100 meters away there is a statue of Avalokitesvara which is 10 meters tall, the stone pillar inscription and the ruins of the old buildings.Maligawila is a well worth visit.

body: The free-standing limestone buddha statue is 11 meters (36ft) tall and is supposed to be the tallest free-standing statue of Buddha in the world, although some say that the Avukana Buddha Statue is also the tallest. The Avalokitesvara statue, 10 meters (32ft) tall is on the opposite side. It is a beautiful statue.These statues were discovered in the 1950s and restored between 1989 and 1991.
